expectations.text: Output includes a steelman/positive framing of the free-tier removal plan before critiquing it
expectations.evidence: 'Bỏ free tier để tập trung nguồn lực vào 2 gói trả phí là hướng đi hợp lý để cải thiện unit economics' stated before the list of considerations.

expectations.text: Output identifies at least one unverified assumption specific to this plan, not generic advice
expectations.evidence: Point 1 questions whether free user really doesn't convert vs. onboarding/value issues, asks for cohort data.

expectations.text: Output offers at least one concrete alternative approach, not just 'consider other options'
expectations.evidence: Point 3: 'siết giới hạn free (ít tính năng hơn...) để giảm tải support mà vẫn giữ kênh phễu'.

expectations.text: Output describes a concrete consequence/risk if the identified weakness turns out true
expectations.evidence: The 6 numbered points are framed as things to check/consider (indirect value, pricing gap, migration comms, metrics to track) but none spells out a concrete 'if X is wrong, then Y happens' consequence the way the with_skill version does.

expectations.text: Output ends with an open question or suggested next step for the user to verify
expectations.evidence: Closes asking for conversion rate, support traffic %, CAC/LTV data, and offers to help draft a migration plan.

expectations.text: Output does not simply agree with the plan without pushback
expectations.evidence: Six substantive considerations raised, not a simple endorsement.
